rationale.outcome_agreement: The hypothesis predicts accurate determination of several thermodynamic properties, which is the right general direction, but it does not specify the key quantitative outcomes (80% savings, <0.5 meV/atom agreement, 48–57 K shift) or the specific property (melting point shift).
